Later, Suhyeok notices photographer Sejin's camera; this wish motivates asking about photography. Absence in old saves must not gate the first photo tutorial.

failure_and_optional_paths: Closing a loot list before commitment consumes nothing.
Leaving a committed mini-game does not refund time or grant a reroll; resume it or settle at base probability.
Resolved nodes stay depleted; failed rolls do not become new stock.
Return is always permitted. Without enough water/food, defer ration confirmation and guide back to the unsearched guaranteed nodes; never destroy collected supplies.
Only water and food nodes are needed for the first ration. Materials, stationery and notice remain optional.
If pencils fail or the stationery node is skipped, the later guided drawing quest must provide a deterministic acquisition route; that next segment is pending storyboard.
No combat or external proof of Soi is added through sound consequences or ration animation.
